row: Tune into Western Sydney Local Health District’s channel for the best health videos in the west. Our multimedia team produces a range of videos, which aim to entertain, inform and educate. We aim to engage our staff with a range of “how to” videos, recordings of key events and lectures and other health tools. We aim to appeal to the commercial market with videos that make you laugh, make you feel and spread our health messages.
